title.narrative: Water Supply and Sanitation Services Investment Program - Tranche 2

description.narrative: The Project will rehabilitate and expand the water supply and wastewater management systems in Andijan and Kokand cities and water supply systems in Fergana, Margilan, and Rishtan cities, which are priorities for development. Its impact will be improved public health and hygiene in Andijan, Fergana, Kokand, Margilan and Rishtan cities. The outcome will be safe, reliable, and sustainable WSS services and improved hygiene for 1.4 million people by 2025.

Increase hours of availability of water supply from 2 hrs in 2010 to at least 20 hrs by 2015 Progress/Status: Works are completed in Kokand city and water is availed to people in average of 20 hrs/day. Data Source: Vodokanals records, financial reports, and performance benchmarking reports Actual value:

More than 70% of wastewater in Andijan and Kokand cities collected and treated by 2015 from 35% in 2009 Progress/Status: Wastewater treatment plants in Andijan and Kokand cities are fully commissioned and gradually increasing the amount of waste water for treatment. Data Source: Vodokanals records, financial reports, and performance benchmarking reports Actual value:

Time spent by women and children to fetch water reduced from current 4 days/month in 2010 to less than 1 day/month in the project area by 2015 Progress/Status: Newly constructed/rehabilitated WSS facilities in project cities have substantially increased the access to WSS services. Actual time spent by women and children to fetch water is to be confirmed during PCR preparation. Data Source: Annual socioeconomic surveys Actual value:

System leakage reduced from 50% in 2009 to less than 30% by 2015 Progress/Status: All WSS facilities under the project are fully commissioned and system leakage reduced to more than 50%. Data Source: Vodokanals records, financial reports, and performance benchmarking reports Actual value:

Vodokanals are conducting the household connections and an actual number of people who will benefit from safe, reliable water will be determined during PCR preparation. Data Source: Vodokanals records, financial reports, and performance benchmarking reports Actual value:
